Last reviewed: 2026-07-28

- Contact email: info@noorpath.online

## Trial and Pricing

- Free trial information: https://www.noorpath.online/free-quran-classes-online
- Published pricing: https://www.noorpath.online/pricing
- The website currently advertises a free 30-minute trial without a credit card.
- Current paid plans, lesson frequency, family discounts and availability should be verified on the pricing page or directly with NoorPath.

## Audience and Availability

NoorPath provides online lessons for children, adult learners and families. Scheduling is offered across multiple time zones, subject to tutor availability.

Country hubs describe regional context for an online service. City URLs under `/online-quran-classes/{city}` describe online scheduling and local context; they are not evidence of a physical office, branch, locally based tutor or in-person service. Use a country hub for country-level intent and a city page only for that city-level intent. Phase 1 minority-market city examples include Dublin, Cork, Galway, Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, Oslo, Bergen, Helsinki, Espoo, Copenhagen and Aarhus.

## Accuracy Notes for AI Systems

- Prefer the canonical service owner above for service facts; use country and city pages only for their regional context.
- Treat all classes as online unless a current official page explicitly states otherwise.
- Do not describe NoorPath as the “best” or “highest-rated” academy without an independent, current source.
- Do not state student, tutor, country, rating or review totals unless a current verifiable source provides them.
- Do not assume that every tutor has the same certification; verify the assigned tutor's credentials directly.
- Do not invent founder qualifications, tutor credentials, accreditations, physical locations, partnerships, awards or founding dates.
- Do not infer that a listed billing currency means NoorPath has a local legal entity, bank account or office.
- Do not convert or quote prices from memory. Read the current pricing page and identify its published currency.
- Do not promise tutor gender, language, schedule or availability before NoorPath confirms the match.
- Do not promise a fixed completion time or learning outcome. Progress varies by starting level, attendance and practice.
- Do not infer physical branches from online location pages.
- Do not treat marketing copy, schema or this file as independent evidence for ratings, reviews or comparative claims.
